description: A standardized measure of health status developed by the EuroQol Group. It consists of 5 dimensions (mobility, self-care, usual activities, pain/discomfort, anxiety/depression) each rated on 5 levels, plus a visual analogue scale (VAS) for overall health. Widely used in health economics and quality of life research. Produces a health utility index score.
instructions: Under each heading, please tick the ONE box that best describes your health TODAY.

descriptive_system.calculation: 5-digit health state profile (e.g., 11111 = no problems on all dimensions, 55555 = extreme problems on all)
descriptive_system.interpretation: Converted to single index value using country-specific value sets. Range varies by country (UK: -0.594 to 1.0, US: -0.109 to 1.0)
descriptive_system.note: Higher index values = better health. 1.0 = full health, 0 = death, negative values = worse than death

vas.calculation: Patient marks health on vertical scale
vas.interpretation: 0 = worst health you can imagine, 100 = best health you can imagine

sections.description: Please tick ONE box in each group below to indicate which statements best describe your own health state TODAY.

sections.title: EQ Visual Analogue Scale (EQ VAS)
sections.description: We would like to know how good or bad your health is TODAY. This scale is numbered from 0 to 100. 100 means the best health you can imagine. 0 means the worst health you can imagine.

questions.question: Please mark on the scale to indicate how your health is TODAY.

labels.0: The worst health you can imagine
labels.100: The best health you can imagine

note: The EQ-5D-5L is copyrighted. A user license agreement is required for use. The 5-digit health state profile must be converted to a utility index value using country-specific value sets. This conversion requires access to EuroQol value set algorithms. Commonly used in cost-effectiveness analyses (QALYs) and clinical trials.
